title: New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978, Chapter 50 (Employment Law), Article 4 - Labor Conditions; Payment of Wages
verified_how: Same chapter page as above (item 4420, browser, 23 September 2026): 'ARTICLE 4 Labor Conditions; Payment of Wages' present in the table of contents of the current NMSA 1978 collection, not marked repealed.
notes: Listed a second time because it is the same statute serving a second topic. New Mexico is an at-will employment state with no severance-pay statute and no mini-WARN Act, so the only statutory rules on ending employment are the final-wage rules in this article (timing of payment on discharge and on resignation). Entitlement after job loss sits in the Unemployment Compensation Law, NMSA 1978 ch. 51, art. 1 (https://nmonesource.com/nmos/nmsa/en/item/4425/index.do), which I also verified as present and unrepealed; it is recorded here as a cross-reference rather than as this topic's Act.
